versions.changelog: Added legal disclaimer and softened description for security scanner

Initial release of clone-anywebsite – a visual-first, high-fidelity web cloning toolkit.

- Introduces a step-by-step cloning guide focused on screenshots and targeted DOM interrogation for pixel-perfect results.
- Provides a robust folder/component structure for scalable React/Tailwind codebases.
- Details a workflow balancing rapid structural build (80%) with precision design/token extraction (20%).
- Supplies modular scripts for extracting typography, layout, box-shadows, complex gradients, glassmorphism, and dynamic backgrounds.
- Specifically addresses challenges of copying Framer/Webflow-generated sites, "div soup", and modern web effects.
